name: Find Love or Die Trying: Til Death Do Us Part
source:
Continue your romance with your chosen partner in the world beyond the killer dating show. Will your love survive, when the world turns against you?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3329650/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
离开那档夺命的相亲节目后，到外面的世界去，和你选中的伴侣继续这段恋情。当整个世界都与你们为敌，你们的爱情还能长存吗？

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3329650/]Steam[/url]］
